answer: Random transcript audit works like this: per epoch the chain selects one past answer at random and issues a fresh nonce, forcing the author to re-derive it live within 90 seconds. Cheap Sybil farms fail here, since one operator cannot re-derive 5,000 answer transcripts at once. On mismatch, the identity is walked out to the terrace of manual review, its stake frozen; two mismatches and it is pushed off the canyon ledge, deposit slashed. Forging 10,000 identities costs roughly $40,000 in bonded stake before any audit even bites.
